verdicts.title: Logic of left variable inclusion and Plonka sums of matrices
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The paper aims at studying, in full generality, logics defined by imposing a variable inclusion condition on a given logic $\vdash$. It turns out that the algebraic counterpart of the variable inclusion companion of a given logic $\vdash$ is obtained by constructing the Plonka sum of the matrix models of $\vdash$. This association allows to obtain a Hilbert-style axiomatization of the logics of variable inclusion and to describe the structure of their reduced models.

verdicts.title: Axiomatizations and Computability of Weighted Monadic Second-Order Logic
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Weighted monadic second-order logic is a weighted extension of monadic second-order logic that captures exactly the behaviour of weighted automata. Its semantics is parameterized with respect to a semiring on which the values that weighted formulas output are evaluated.
